Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
He who offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah,

people.name: Amminadab
people.line: Father-in-law of Aaron, ancestor of David

people.name: Nahshon
people.line: Son of Amminadab, leader of Judah, ancestor of David.

translations.web: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.
translations.bsb: First, the divisions of the camp of Judah set out under their standard, with Nahshon son of Amminadab in command.
translations.kjv: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
translations.asv: And in the first place the standard of the camp of the children of Judah set forward according to their hosts: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
